verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a 'vastai agent skill' that lets AI coding assistants drive the platform via natural-language-style commands (create instances, deploy endpoints, manage keys, check balances), and the CLI/SDK/API underpin this. However, this is a specific skill/plugin addition rather than a native chat interface, and there is no independent or hands-on evidence confirming it works well in practice. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the agent skill working reliably, and evidence of a first-party conversational/chat interface beyond the CLI-driven skill.
